as_told.title: Lazar's own research into a repelling force distinct from gravity

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien flying saucers at a secret site in Nevada in the late 1980s, is said to be still doing experiments in his own home lab. Michels says that Lazar "is currently working on exotic UFO science in his personal lab," and Lazar himself tells Michels that after 30 years of his own research he is "more convinced" he was right that a pushing force separate from ordinary gravity exists. If true, the physics he described decades ago would still hold up on his own bench.
